minimal_design: Keep actual owner candle watermark and merged frame ranges; persist verified immutable history chunks across generations, fetch only advancing windows and finite catchup. Funding uses separate actual settlement watermark and finite confirmation overlap; changed historical bytes produce explicit conflict/new version, never overwrite or zero-impute.

CAS original public response bytes by SHA256, immutable verified readback; append one bounded receipt for EVERY real attempted call including failure/partial/duplicate content. Dedup never fabricates a call, fresh ticker timestamp, received_at or ACK.

Seal finite append-only receipt/index segments referencing immutable payload hashes and exact profile/runtime/run/generation; index all generations. Segment/accounting commitments must survive restart and backup. Do not introduce a financial registry or authority.

Reserve bounded incoming bytes/files and free-space headroom against aggregate active+sealed+failed captures BEFORE dispatch; refuse new acquisition when full without deleting history or resetting on restart. Permit only explicit verified segmented archival; original references remain resolvable. Replace per-poll full recursive scan with bounded committed segment accounting plus fail-closed reconciliation.

Capacity/fetch failures remain typed unavailable/stale observations and retain actual request accounting; existing Paper management/protection and owned child cancellation/reaping remain isolated. No long-duration acceptance inferred.
proposed_tests_not_executed: Unchanged candle boundary: ticker only; actual new boundary: one merged history fetch; bounded multi-frame bootstrap/catchup; backward/future clock and boundary-cross rejection with unchanged durable watermark.
Repeated identical response bytes: one CAS object, distinct actual call receipts; changed timestamp/price bytes: distinct object; corrupted referenced bytes and delayed/revised funding reject.

Aggregate byte/file capacity pre-reservation, failed/partial attempts counted, restart/new runtime cannot reset budget, sealed segment index/readback/backup restoration preserves accounting; no deletion on refusal.
Slow/oversize/hung public child and full-volume faults cannot stall management/protection; bounded cancel/reap, unknown incomplete call count preserved rather than false zero.
